blockingFindings: The canonical workflow documentation contradicts the new enforced lifecycle. docs/project/TASK_WORKFLOW.md still instructs V2 verification with evidence/tasks/<task>/verification.md and does not describe the required source-head, evidence-head, and lifecycle-head sequence, while task-cli.mjs now rejects that evidence and requires the exact final review artifact from a committed evidence-only head. This governed command would fail for operators and CI. The documentation path is outside the packet allowlist, so correction requires a narrowly approved packet amendment before merge.
nonBlockingRisks: The accumulated historical review evidence remains large and increases audit and context-budget pressure, although the bounded-digest treatment and unchanged task-local ceiling currently contain it.

POSIX cancellation deliberately avoids escalation after the original child closes; an unusual descendant that survives its group leader could require separate operational diagnosis, but no review result would be persisted.
missingNegativeTests: Add deterministic documentation/CLI parity coverage proving the documented V2 verification sequence uses the exact final review artifact, commits the evidence-only head, and produces a schema-valid reviewVerification object with distinct headSha and evidenceHeadSha.

architectureAssessment.deepModules: Review parsing, bounded output, cancellation, evidence sequencing, and publication are encapsulated behind focused functions, though task-cli.mjs now carries a substantial lifecycle-validation surface whose public workflow contract must remain synchronized with permanent documentation.
architectureAssessment.hexagonalArchitecture: The repair remains within repository orchestration and evidence adapters; it does not grant model, provider, deployment, production, payment, or P3-001 authority.
architectureAssessment.eventedBoundaries: Child output, cancellation, review binding, terminal provenance, atomic publication, and source-to-evidence lifecycle transitions are explicit fail-closed boundaries with deterministic validation.

exactNextAction: Have the Chief Orchestrator obtain the smallest packet amendment adding docs/project/TASK_WORKFLOW.md, update its V2 lifecycle and command examples to the enforced exact-final-review-artifact and evidence-head sequence, add the parity regression, rerun every packet-required check, and submit a fresh immutable head for plan, semantic, and merge-risk review.
